about: COOK PROPS 11/3 (rule 341, rule 337): each place's own things as real models through the master rig, for COMBAT MAPS 3 to place on its boards. tools/bohemia_cook_props_every_place_its_own_11_3_26.py
camera: orthographic, tilted 45 from straight down, facing north, never turned; heights drawn full (x 1/cos45); one sun upper left
front: every model faces -Y (south, the camera); turn it on a board in quarters; its origin is its ground centre, metres, z up
anchor: anchor_px is the model's ground centre (its origin) in its picture, from the top-left pixel

role_key.cover: stops a shot, a man stands behind it
role_key.none: stands there, the fight walks past it

tile_key.H: height (+1 level, a roof or ledge you climb)
flat; the thing is a piece on it

models.name: THE CAGE BLOCK
models.what: four steel holding cages on a concrete plinth under a lean-to roof, numbered; cage three burst open from inside, its door torn off and thrown out into the yard, the bars beside it bowed out
models.wrong: the bars of cage three are bent OUTWARD, toward you; the straw is dragged out after it

models.name: TWO GURNEYS
models.what: two transport gurneys: one standing with its straps still buckled across an empty mattress and its drip pole, one knocked over on its side with its mattress slid off
models.wrong: the standing gurney's straps are buckled shut, tight, across nothing

models.name: THE DECON SHOWER
models.what: a portable decontamination shower: a tube frame under a sheet roof, plastic curtains on three sides (one torn open), two shower roses, a yellow catch berm, its pump on a skid with the hoses run out, a hazmat suit hung on the frame

models.name: THE COLD-STORE TRUCK
models.what: a refrigerated box truck backed up to the cages, its cab dead, its back doors swung open on an empty box, the reefer unit on the box's nose
models.wrong: the reefer is still running: its panel lit and frost white on the open doors, in the desert, with no one paying for the diesel

models.name: LAB FENCE, A RUN
models.what: six metres of 2.4 m security chain-link on galvanised posts, barbed wire on V-arms and a razor coil riding in the V, a yellow biohazard plate wired to the fabric

models.name: LAB GATE, ONE LEAF DOWN
models.what: a double vehicle gate in the same fence, 4 m between its posts: the left leaf shut on its chain and padlock, the right leaf torn off its top hinge and hanging, its corner dug into the ground; the gap is a way through

models.name: THE PLANE ON ITS BELLY
models.what: a 19-seat twin turboprop (a Beechcraft 1900 at its true 17.6 m) down on its belly on the apron, gear folded under it, the left wingtip on the ground, both propellers curled back, its airstair door open

models.name: THE FUEL TRUCK
models.what: an airport refueller: a cab-over cab, a 5,000 gallon tank, a walkway rail on top, the hose reel at the back with its hose run out across the apron to a nozzle lying on nothing; the Jet A placard

models.name: THE BAGGAGE CARTS
models.what: a baggage tug and three covered carts in a train that slewed as it stopped, each cart still loaded
models.wrong: every suitcase on every cart is the same suitcase: the same size, the same colour, stacked the same way

models.name: THE JET BRIDGE STUB
models.what: a jet bridge standing alone where its terminal was: the rotunda on its column, a corrugated tunnel 4 m up running out to its cab, the drive column on its two wheels, the service stair from the cab down to the apron; its terminal end torn off. You walk under it; the stair climbs to it

models.name: THE HANGAR'S OPEN FRONT
models.what: the front bay of a steel hangar, 24 m wide and 9 m to the eaves: its sliding door leaves run back to both ends on their track, one leaf jumped its track and leaning, the dark inside, roof sheets gone, a caged ladder up the side to the roof

models.name: THE CLUBHOUSE FRONT
models.what: a desert-modern clubhouse, 22 m by 11 m: stucco walls, a clay-tile mansard round a flat roof you can stand on, a portico of five arches, its doors and windows boarded, dead shrubs in its planters, a ladder left at the side

models.name: A GOLF CART, DEAD
models.what: an electric golf cart left on the fairway: its canopy sagging, one front tyre flat, a bag of clubs on the back

models.name: A GOLF CART ON ITS SIDE
models.what: the same cart, pushed over on its side: its floor toward you, a low wall a man kneels behind

models.name: THE FLAG ON A DEAD GREEN
models.what: a green gone to straw, raised a little over the fairway in its fringe, the cup cut in it, the pin and its flag
models.wrong: the flag is new: a bright yellow cloth standing straight out from the pin, with no wind, on the only thing on the course anyone still tends

models.name: THE TEE: A BALL WASHER AND ITS BENCH
models.what: a tee's furniture: the ball washer on its post with its crank and a rag on the hook, a slatted bench, the two tee markers, a bin, the hole's sign on its post

models.name: A DEAD PALM
models.what: a Mexican fan palm 11.5 m tall, the kind the valley planted along every fairway: its crown dead brown, two fronds snapped, the skirt of dead fronds nobody trimmed hanging down its trunk

models.name: A PALM DOWN
models.what: the same palm fallen across the fairway, its crown smashed on the ground: a long low log a man lies behind, its dead fronds rough ground to cross

models.name: A TRAILER ON BLOCKS
models.what: a 16 m single-wide on cinder-block piers, its skirt half fallen so you see the blocks, aluminium siding, a crowned roof, a window unit, one window boarded, pallets for steps, its tongue still on

models.name: A TRAILER BURNT OUT
models.what: the next single-wide burnt to its shell: black walls, its roof fallen into the middle, ash on the floor, its rafters bare

models.name: THE PROPANE TANKS
models.what: the park's 500 gallon tank (the kit's own model, whole) and two 100 pound bottles chained to a post beside it; hit one and the ground burns

models.name: A CARPORT
models.what: a steel carport, 6 m by 3.6 m on four posts, one post buckled so the roof sags to a corner; under it a couch and a stack of tyres (the kit's own)

models.name: THE CLOTHESLINE
models.what: two T-posts 6 m apart and three lines between them, the washing pegged out on them, a basket on the gravel
models.wrong: the washing is spotless white, the only clean thing in the park, pegged out fresh, and nobody lives here

models.name: A JOSHUA TREE
models.what: a Joshua tree 4.6 m tall, branched twice, each arm ending in its fist of spikes, the dead leaves shagging its limbs

models.name: A YOUNG JOSHUA TREE
models.what: a younger Joshua tree, 3 m, branched once

models.name: BOULDERS
models.what: four granite boulders, desert-varnished dark on top and pale where they split, the biggest 1.7 m: cover a man crouches behind

models.name: A DEAD CAR HALF BURIED
models.what: a sedan (the kit's own wreck, whole) half under a sand drift, its nose down in the dune, sand piled over its bonnet and up its doors

models.name: A POWER PYLON DOWN
models.what: a 24 m steel lattice transmission tower snapped at its footings and lying on its face across the desert, its arms and insulators in the dirt, its conductors trailing off; its legs still stand where it broke. You see through it, you go round it

models.name: A SANDSTONE LEDGE, ONE STOREY
models.what: a slickrock ledge 12 m by 9 m and 3 m high, its beds of rust and cream sandstone stepping in as they rise, potholes on its flat top: height you climb to

models.name: A SANDSTONE LEDGE, TWO STOREYS
models.what: the same rock, 6 m high: a step up from the one-storey ledge, its face too steep to climb but from the lower one

models.name: A SANDSTONE LEDGE, THREE STOREYS
models.what: the top step, 9 m high, the highest ground on any board
models.wrong: on its top, where nobody could climb, a cairn of stones somebody stacked

models.name: A SANDSTONE FIN
models.what: an Aztec sandstone fin 14 m long, 2.5 m thick and 10 m tall, weathered round on top, its cross-bedded bands running along it: a wall across the board you go round or hold

models.name: THE SLOT CANYON'S WALLS
models.what: two sandstone walls 12 m long and 7 m high, curving together with a slot 1.1 m wide between them: one man at a time walks through it

models.name: GUARD RAIL, A RUN
models.what: 12 m of W-beam guard rail on its posts at the road's edge, one section hit and folded out over the drop, the reflectors on its posts

models.name: A ROCKFALL
models.what: limestone blocks down off the cut face across half the road, the biggest 2.6 m, a fan of scree under them: a heap you climb for the shot, or go round

models.name: A JACKKNIFED TRUCK
models.what: a semi folded on the grade: the tractor turned across the road, its 16 m trailer swung round behind it, its back doors open
models.wrong: the trailer is empty and white inside, spotless, in a valley of dust

models.name: THE ROAD CLOSED
models.what: a road-closed barricade (three striped boards on its legs), its sign bent, and three drums beside it, left when the pass was shut and never opened

models.name: THE INTAKE TOWER
models.what: a water intake tower standing out on the dry bed: a concrete drum 8 m across and 14 m tall, trash racks on its sides, its gantry crane on top, a walkway stub that went to shore, the white ring where the water stood

models.name: A DOCK ON DRY LAND
models.what: a floating dock section 12 m long come to rest on the mud on its black floats, tilted, its planks warped, its cleats and rail, a gangway climbing from it to nothing: a deck a man stands up on

models.name: A BOAT ON ITS SIDE
models.what: a 7 m runabout lying on its side in the cracked mud where the water left it, its hull to you, its outboard in the air
models.wrong: its anchor line runs taut down into the dry mud, as if something under there is holding it

models.name: THE BUOYS
models.what: a channel can buoy on its side in the mud, its chain run out, and a white no-wake buoy standing up on its sinker with no water within a mile

models.name: THE CULVERT
models.what: a twin box culvert under a road: its concrete headwall 10 m wide, two dark mouths 3 m wide you walk through, its wingwalls, the road slab on top; tags on the headwall, the drift of the last flood piled at the mouths

models.name: A SHOPPING CART IN THE SILT
models.what: a shopping cart (the kit's own, whole) on its side half sunk in the silt, the flood's drift caught in its wires

models.name: A SOFA IN THE SILT
models.what: a three-seat sofa sunk to its seat in the silt, its cushions gone, a floor lamp standing beside it on its own
models.wrong: the floor lamp is lit, plugged into nothing

models.name: THE DEBRIS JAM
models.what: what the last flood left against a boulder: a dead tamarisk trunk, tyres, a mattress, a door, plastic: low cover a man lies behind, rough ground to cross

models.name: AN EMPTY POOL
models.what: a kidney pool dug into its concrete deck, empty: faded plaster, the tile band, its ladder and diving board, the leaves and a chair at the deep end; a pit a man climbs down into. The board must cut its ground to the deck (hole_m in the manifest)
models.wrong: in the deep end, two fingers of perfectly clear water, and no rain in a year

hole_m.about: a pit: cut the board's ground inside this ellipse round the model's origin

models.name: A BACKYARD CORNER
models.what: the split-face block walls every Vegas backyard has, 1.8 m, two runs meeting at a corner with its pilaster, a wrought-iron side gate hanging open, a bin against it: walls you fight along and over

models.name: A DEAD SWING SET
models.what: a steel A-frame swing set 3.6 m wide, its slide gone to rust, two swings on their chains
models.wrong: one swing hangs straight; the other is stopped high in the air at the top of its arc, and stays there

models.name: A TRAMPOLINE FRAME
models.what: a backyard trampoline's frame, 4.3 m across, its mat rotted out, its net poles leaning, its springs hanging

models.name: A TRASH MOUND
models.what: a mound of the valley's trash 12 m across and 4 m high, the cover soil eroded off it: bags, boxes, tyres, a fridge, a mattress, a shopping cart poking out of it: height you climb

models.name: THE METHANE FLARE
models.what: the landfill gas flare: a 9 m steel stack on its concrete pad, its wind shield at the top, the knockout drum and the header pipe feeding it, a fence round it; the ground round it burns
models.wrong: it is still burning: the flame up top, years after anyone paid for anything

models.name: THE DEAD DOZER
models.what: a bulldozer (the kit's own, whole) stopped mid-push, its blade full of the trash it was moving, a windrow of it beside the track it left

models.name: THE GAS HEADER
models.what: the landfill gas wells: white pipe wellheads standing out of the cover with their valves, a 0.6 m header pipe running 12 m along the ground on its saddles between them: a low wall of pipe

models.name: THE DRY FOUNTAIN
models.what: a casino plaza fountain 12 m across, dry: its marble rim knee high all round (cover), its three-tier centre, the stained floor, the coins still in it

models.name: A FALLEN CASINO SIGN
models.what: a 12 m arrow sign down on the plaza off its snapped pylon, tilted on its edge, its rows of bulbs, its letters' ghosts
models.wrong: one bulb, out of the hundred, is still lit

models.name: THE BRIDGE SPAN
models.what: a span of the Boulevard's pedestrian bridge, 14 m on two pylons, its deck 6 m up, its glass sides broken out, the escalator at one end stopped: you walk under it, you climb it by the escalator

models.name: A STRETCH LIMO
models.what: a white stretch limousine, 9 m, dead at the valet line, its tyres flat, its dark windows, a door open

models.name: A BAY OF THE CANOPY
models.what: one bay of the Fremont canopy over the street: two steel columns 13 m apart, the curved lattice rib between them, a 3 m band of its screen panels underneath (the board repeats the bay down the street); under it no shot comes from a roof
models.wrong: one panel of the dead screen is still showing a picture, a few squares of colour, the same ones, all night

models.name: ALLEY DUMPSTERS
models.what: two dumpsters (the kit's own, whole) in the alley, one tipped on its side and spilled, the bags piled round them

models.name: AN ALLEY WALL AND ITS FIRE ESCAPE
models.what: the brick back of a three-storey downtown hotel, 10 m of it, its fire escape zigzagging up to the roof, a steel back door, window units, a drop ladder hanging: the way up to a roof

models.name: THE DEUCE, BURNT
models.what: a double-decker Strip-and-downtown bus burnt out where it stopped: 13 m long, 4.4 m high, its shell black, both decks' windows empty, its tyres gone to the rims

models.name: A BOXCAR
models.what: a 50 foot boxcar on its trucks on a short run of track, its door slid open on the dark inside, rust down its sides, the ladder at its end to its roof

models.name: A TANK CAR
models.what: a black tank car on its trucks, its dome and walkway, a hazmat placard; it burns if it is hit

models.name: THE GANTRY CRANE, A CAR ON ITS HOOK
models.what: a yard gantry crane: two A-frame legs 8 m tall on rail wheels, the beam 14 m across them, the trolley and its hook; you fight between its legs
models.wrong: a car (the kit's own wreck) hangs from the hook over your head, and nobody is at the controls

models.name: THE MACHINES
models.what: a shop's machines dragged out onto the slab: a 4 m hydraulic press, a lathe on its bed, an air compressor, a crate; cover between them

models.name: A STACK OF PIPE
models.what: steel pipe 0.9 m across stacked three high on timber chocks, 9 m long: a wall of cover, and a man can stand in its ends

models.name: A HOUSEBOAT ON THE DRY BED
models.what: a Lake Mead houseboat, 18 m, sat down on the cracked bed on its pontoons, listing: its cabin, its windows, the top deck with its rail and its water slide, the ladder up: a roof you take
models.wrong: a fresh towel lies at the foot of the slide, where you would land in the water

models.name: A CRUISER ON ITS KEEL
models.what: an 11 m cabin cruiser sat on its keel in the mud, heeled over 14 degrees, its flybridge and its cabin windows

models.name: A BASS BOAT ON ITS TRAILER
models.what: a 6 m bass boat still strapped on its rusted trailer, both trailer tyres flat and sunk in the mud, its tongue down
